configureMiningSystem(address).details: Call path: owner -> TeamPerformance.configureMiningSystem; then MiningSystem/ -> TeamPerformance.updatePerformance.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

setHoldingRequirement(uint8,uint256).details: Call path: operator -> TeamPerformance.setHoldingRequirement; the new value applies when MiningSystem updates performance or any caller invokes TeamPerformance.refreshLevel. A zero value disables the holding requirement for that level.

setOperator(address).details: Call path: owner -> TeamPerformance.setOperator; the new operator may subsequently call TeamPerformance.setHoldingRequirement.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

setHoldingRequirement(uint8,uint256).notice: Sets the USDT value of MÖB that a wallet must hold to qualify for one V2-V7 level.

setOperator(address).notice: Sets the operator that configures V2-V7 MÖB holding requirements.
